title: 第11章 坦白局-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》
content:
第(1/3)页

    这一幕有些熟悉，不知道是帽子叔叔来扫皇呢....

    下意识用手挡了挡，他眯缝着眼睛看清情况，忍不住骂道：“大晚上的关什么灯，玩击剑吗？”

    只见陈贺坐在中间，杜姜郑凯坐在两边，三人手里拿着手电筒，表情严肃。

    他们面前还摆着从校门口烧烤店老板那里顺过来的折叠桌子，桌子上面摆了十几瓶啤酒、两瓶白酒以及一些下酒菜。

    “魏沐，咱都是爷们，今天来场坦白局，你把真实情况一五一十的给我们讲讲。”

    陈贺起开一瓶啤酒，砰的一下放到桌上。

    “呵呵，坦白局是吧？”

    看到这一幕，魏沐笑着拿过来一把椅子坐上去，他挑了挑眉毛，撸起袖子，手指着对面三人。

    “就你们这三个菜鸡，能喝的过我？”

    因为体质特殊，原主这幅身体很能喝。

    以前没发觉，直到高考之后的那次升学宴。

    第一次被舅老爷撺掇着喝酒，就把混迹酒场几十年的老手灌趴下。

    从此声名大噪。

    之后几年，逢年过节少不了一番恶战，有的自觉能力不行，便拉帮结派联手围攻。

    最后往往落得一个东倒西歪的下场，而被群殴的魏沐却跟没事人一样活蹦乱跳。

    这四年来，宿舍几个没少出去喝酒，他们当然知道魏沐的厉害。

    不过今天是坦白局，不是拼酒局！！

    或许被魏沐的气势吓到，陈贺有些怂了。

    他看了看两边酒量不好的郑凯和杜姜，扯着嗓子喊：“少废话，先说说录歌是怎么回事。”

    这没必要隐瞒，他已经从李金明那里听说了走后发生的事情。

    陈贺这小子可以，真给他打听到了具体情况。

    “行了，都是兄弟，先来一轮再说。”

    魏沐没有解释，而是又起开两瓶啤酒给他们满上。

    一轮之后，他说道：“你们知道那天晓晨跟我分手的事吧？”

    “知道。”

    “别看我当天晚上就出去约会，其实心里还是很难受，然后便想写首歌纪念我那死去的爱情。”

    “那高小松和老狼是怎么回事？”

    “哦.....我有亲戚和那边比较熟，她听了我的歌，便把这首歌推荐过去。正巧..........”

    魏沐没有说秦兰的事情。

    原主比较低调，从入学开始就没提秦兰的事情，现在提起这个反而有一直瞒着他们的意思。

    见魏沐刻意避开，他们没有继续追问。

    谁没有几个秘密呢。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

This scene is a bit familiar, I didn’t know it was Uncle Hat coming to defeat the emperor...

Subconsciously blocking it with his hand, he squinted his eyes to see the situation clearly, and couldn't help but curse: "Why turn off the lights at night, are you playing fencing?"

I saw Chen He sitting in the middle and Du Jiang and Zheng Kai sitting on both sides. The three of them held flashlights in their hands and looked serious.

There was also a folding table in front of them from the owner of the barbecue restaurant at the school gate. There were more than a dozen bottles of beer, two bottles of liquor and some snacks on the table.

"Wei Mu, we are all men. Today we have a confessional. Tell us the real situation."

Chen Heqi opened a bottle of beer and put it on the table with a bang.

"Haha, it's a confession, right?"

Seeing this scene, Wei Mu smiled, took a chair and sat on it. He raised his eyebrows, rolled up his sleeves, and pointed at the three people opposite him.

"Can you three noobs drink better than me?"

Because of his special constitution, the original owner was very capable of drinking.

I didn’t realize it before, until the entrance banquet after the college entrance examination.

The first time I was persuaded by my uncle to drink, he forced me down, a veteran who had been in the wine shop for decades.

Since then it has become famous.

In the following years, fierce battles were inevitable during festivals and festivals. Some felt that they were not capable enough, so they formed gangs and joined forces to besiege.

In the end, Wei Mu often ends up staggering around, but Wei Mu, who is beaten by a group of people, is as active as a normal person.

In the past four years, several people in the dormitory have been out drinking frequently. Of course they know how powerful Wei Mu is.

But today is a confession round, not a drinking round!!

Perhaps Chen He was frightened by Wei Mu's momentum.

He looked at Zheng Kai and Du Jiang, who were both drunk, and shouted at the top of his lungs: "Stop talking nonsense, let's talk about recording songs first."

There is no need to hide this, he has already heard from Li Jinming what happened after he left.

Chen He, this boy can do it. I really asked him about the specific situation.

"Okay, we are all brothers, let's have a round first and then talk about it."

Wei Mu did not explain, but opened two more bottles of beer and filled them for them.

After one round, he said: "You know what happened when Xiaochen broke up with me that day, right?"

"I know."

"Even though I went out on a date that night, I still felt very sad, so I wanted to write a song to commemorate my dead love."

"Then what's going on with Gao Xiaosong and Lao Lang?"

"Oh...I have a relative who is familiar with that place. She heard my song and recommended this song to her. It just so happened..."

Wei Mu didn’t say anything about Qin Lan.

The original owner is relatively low-key and has not mentioned Qin Lan’s affairs since he entered school. Now that he mentioned it, he meant that he had been hiding it from them.

Seeing that Wei Mu was deliberately avoiding him, they did not continue to ask questions.

Who doesn’t have a few secrets?
